scope: Twelve authored, correlated ChangeBench diagnostic cases. Not independent held-out evaluation.

model_runs.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 14B evidence-v2 plus Git change facts

mismatch.reason: No explicit declared trace supports the stronger BROKEN_TRACE status; retain the conservative finding pending oracle review.

rules_only.interpretation: Same authored development scenarios informed rule work; this is not independent accuracy and must not be reported as a held-out result.

root_causes: The original model prompt did not include explicit Git-derived deleted/added/modified artifact facts, and balanced evidence windows could omit the changed symbol itself.
Providing source-verified evidence-v2 alone raised Qwen2.5 Coder from 1/12 to 2/12, so evidence selection was not the only bottleneck.
Adding Git-derived symbol and diff facts raised the diagnostic result to 4/12, but the model still often predicts CONSISTENT for potential inconsistencies.
The status labels are not interchangeable: the model confuses INCONSISTENT, POTENTIAL_INCONSISTENCY, and UNCERTAIN despite valid citations.
Two Qwen3 model variants in the original run produced invalid citation aliases on all cases; strict validation correctly counts those outputs as errors.
changes_under_test: Added bounded Git/artifact delta facts to production and diagnostic prompts; facts orient the model but are explicitly not proof of a defect.
Versioned the prompt as paired-neutral-v3-change-facts and fingerprinted change_analysis/diff.py in the evaluator.
Fixed duplicate/contradictory deterministic findings for deleted implementation/test relationships.

requested_milestone.status: NOT_RUN; 200 independently reviewed repository-change cases are not available. Do not pad the existing 12 authored cases.

next_valid_step: Obtain independently double-reviewed labels on repository-separated changes, freeze policy/model/prompt on validation data, then evaluate once on held-out repositories. Do not tune repeatedly on these 12 cases.
